        From 1c1bf34951e8d17941bf708d1901c47e81b15d55 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jack Morgenstein <jackm@dev.mellanox.co.il>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2015 16:53:47 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx4_core: Fix wrong index in propagating port change
 event to VFs

The port-change event processing in procedure mlx4_eq_int() uses "slave"
as the vf_oper array index. Since the value of "slave" is the PF function
index, the result is that the PF link state is used for deciding to
propagate the event for all the VFs. The VF link state should be used,
so the VF function index should be used here.

Fixes: 948e306d7d64 ('net/mlx4: Add VF link state support')
Signed-off-by: Jack Morgenstein <jackm@dev.mellanox.co.il>
Signed-off-by: Matan Barak <matanb@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Or Gerlitz <ogerlitz@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c
index aae13adfb492..8e81e53c370e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/eq.c
@@ -601,7 +601,7 @@ static int mlx4_eq_int(struct mlx4_dev *dev, struct mlx4_eq *eq)
 							continue;
 						mlx4_dbg(dev, "%s: Sending MLX4_PORT_CHANGE_SUBTYPE_DOWN to slave: %d, port:%d\n",
 							 __func__, i, port);
-						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[slave].vport[port].state;
+						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[i].vport[port].state;
 						if (IFLA_VF_LINK_STATE_AUTO == s_info->link_state) {
 							eqe->event.port_change.port =
 								cpu_to_be32(
@@ -640,7 +640,7 @@ static int mlx4_eq_int(struct mlx4_dev *dev, struct mlx4_eq *eq)
 							continue;
 						if (i == mlx4_master_func_num(dev))
 							continue;
-						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[slave].vport[port].state;
+						s_info = &priv->mfunc.master.vf_oper[i].vport[port].state;
 						if (IFLA_VF_LINK_STATE_AUTO == s_info->link_state) {
 							eqe->event.port_change.port =
 								cpu_to_be32(
--

        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by using the incorrect index ("slave") to access the virtual function (VF) operational state array (`vf_oper`). Instead of using the VF function index, the code mistakenly used the physical function (PF) index, leading to the propagation of the PF link state instead of the correct VF link state when processing port-change events. This resulted in incorrect behavior when determining the link state for VFs.
